schema.text: Is there a place for people to walk along this street?

options.text: No walking space – people must walk on the road
Edge of the road without a sidewalk
Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on one side
Walking space marked on the ground, at the same level as the road
Path shared by people walking and cycling

en.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Is there a place for people to walk along this street?
en.#No walking space – people must walk on: No walking space – people must walk on the road
en.#Edge of the road without a sidewalk: Edge of the road without a sidewalk
en.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on one side
en.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Walking space marked on the ground, at the same level as the road
en.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Path shared by people walking and cycling

it.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: C'è uno spazio in cui camminare lungo questa strada?
it.#No walking space – people must walk on: Non c'è uno spazio pedonale: occorre camminare sulla carreggiata
it.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Marciapiede, ma si interrompe o c'è solo su un lato
it.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Spazio pedonale segnato a terra, allo stesso livello della strada
it.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Percorso per pedoni e bici insieme

fr.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Y a-t-il un espace où les personnes peuvent marcher le long de cette rue ?
fr.#No walking space – people must walk on: Aucun espace piéton : il faut marcher sur la chaussée
fr.#Edge of the road without a sidewalk: Bord de la route sans trottoir
fr.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Trottoir, mais il s'interrompt ou n'existe que d'un côté
fr.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Espace piéton marqué au sol, au même niveau que la chaussée
fr.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Chemin partagé entre piétons et cyclistes
fr.#Stairway or path with steps: Escalier ou chemin avec des marches

de.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Gibt es entlang dieser Straße einen Bereich zum Gehen?
de.#No walking space – people must walk on: Kein Gehbereich – Personen müssen auf der Fahrbahn gehen
de.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Gehweg, aber er hört auf oder ist nur auf einer Seite
de.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Am Boden markierter Gehbereich auf Fahrbahnhöhe

tr.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Bu sokak boyunca insanların yürüyebileceği bir alan var mı?
tr.#No walking space – people must walk on: Yürüme alanı yok – insanlar yolda yürümek zorunda
tr.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Kaldırım var, ama kesiliyor veya yalnızca bir tarafta
tr.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Yerde işaretlenmiş, yolla aynı seviyede yürüme alanı
tr.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: Yayalar ve bisikletliler için ortak yol

fa.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: آیا در امتداد این خیابان فضایی برای پیاده‌روی وجود دارد؟
fa.#No walking space – people must walk on: فضای پیاده وجود ندارد – مردم باید در جاده راه بروند
fa.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: پیاده‌رو هست، اما قطع می‌شود یا فقط در یک طرف است
fa.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: فضای پیاده‌روی علامت‌گذاری‌شده روی زمین، هم‌سطح خیابان
fa.#Path shared by people walking and cycli: مسیر مشترک عابران پیاده و دوچرخه‌سواران

hu.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: Van gyaloglásra alkalmas hely ezen az utcán?
hu.#No walking space – people must walk on: Nincs gyalogos tér – az úttesten kell gyalogolni
hu.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: Van járda, de megszakad vagy csak az egyik oldalon van
hu.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: Az úttesttel egy szintben, felfestéssel jelölt gyalogos sáv

ar.#Is there a place for people to walk alo: هل توجد مساحة للمشي على طول هذا الشارع؟
ar.#No walking space – people must walk on: لا توجد مساحة للمشي – يجب على الناس المشي في الطريق
ar.#Sidewalk, but it stops or is only on on: يوجد رصيف، لكنه ينقطع أو يوجد في جهة واحدة فقط
ar.#Walking space marked on the ground, at: مساحة مشي محددة بعلامات على الأرض، بمستوى الطريق نفسه
